visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a wide aerial drone shot of the Weiwuying National Kaohsiung Center for the Arts, a large, white, undulating modern building under a soft blue sky with scattered clouds. The city skyline with residential buildings and a distant skyscraper is visible in the background. (2) A sharp cut to a ground-level view of a large white metal shutter door labelled 'West Loading Area'. The door begins to roll upwards, revealing a dark interior. (3) A sequence showing a white semi-truck with a brown shipping container positioned near the loading bay. Inside the dark container, three workers in black clothes and masks are seen moving large black stage equipment cases. (4) A female security guard in a dark vest, white shirt, and black tie stands firmly with her hands on her hips inside a concrete corridor. She adjusts her black uniform cap and maintains a serious facial expression. (5) Two men in casual black clothing push large black flight cases on wheels across a light gray polished concrete floor in a cavernous hall with industrial pipes visible on the ceiling. (6) A ritual altar is shown with offerings including green 'Kuai Kuai' snack bags, bananas, oranges, and a gold incense burner with glowing red sticks. A group of people stand with hands clasped in prayer. (7) A middle-aged man with a gray beard, wearing a dark blue t-shirt and glasses, picks up two incense sticks, bows, and places them in the burner while others behind him pray. (8) A man in a black blazer and glasses picks up a wooden baton (conductors baton) from the floor. He stands and examines it, then talks to a woman holding a large red folder. He walks away through a hallway. (9) A large, pink, egg-shaped mascot character with yellow lips, eyelashes, and a small orange hat walks across the hallway behind the man. (10) A white shutter door rises again, revealing eight performers dressed in black standing in a line. They walk forward together in a slow, synchronized manner towards the camera within a large industrial backstage space. (11) A colorful yellow graphic concludes the video, featuring cartoonish floating candies, a striped lollipop, and the text '2025 Weiwuying Circus Platform' with dates and brand logos.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a professional male narration over an upbeat, cinematic orchestral track with a driving electronic beat. A synthetic 'shutter opening' sound effect triggers as the loading bay visuals appear. (2) Mechanical rolling sounds and truck engine hums are subtly layered under the voiceover. The narrator speaks with a steady, engaging pace. (3) A distinct 'ding' sound effect marks the appearance of the text labels for staff roles. Footstep sounds are heard as the tech crew moves cases. (4) During the prayer scene, a faint crowd murmur and the rustling of incense sticks are audible. The music remains energetic but slightly filtered. (5) A sharp 'whoosh' transition accompanies the scene change to the conductor. A wooden 'click' sound is heard when he picks up the baton. (6) A comedic or 'meme' style chime accompanies the mascot's appearance. (7) The final phase features a crescendo in the music with a bright synthesizer stinger and a definitive final drum hit as the promotional screen displays.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Introduction -> Behind-the-scenes staff showcase -> Call to Action -> Event Reveal.
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: This video serves as a promotional teaser for the '2025 Weiwuying Circus Platform'. It uses a 'behind-the-scenes' narrative to humanize the massive art center by introducing the essential personnel—the 'NPCs' like security, tech crew, and directors—who make the performances possible. By showing the loading dock and rituals, it builds anticipation for the unseen spectacle and invites the audience to discover parts of the theater they never see.
